## If you aren't sure if you need to use a storage service, read on for 8 indicators it may be good to consider self-storage in Mumbai before the mess becomes a greater burden.


It's time to consider **[self storage in Mumbai](https://stownest.com/self-storage-mumbai)** if you have a move with different dates scheduled, are renovating or redeveloping, have a small new home, home appliances , seasonal clutter, or just stuff that you can't bring yourself to part with but doesn't quite fit. If you relate to two or more of these, you probably need storage, and it's not a maybe.


## **Most People Wait Too Long to Consider Storage**


In an expensive real estate market, where homes, especially in Mumbai, are inevitably on the smaller side and compact, there's a natural tendency to develop management strategies for the accumulated clutter as opposed to solving for it. Stacking some items, pushing furniture to the side, telling yourself it's just temporary, is not usually the best solution. These situations tend not to resolve themselves. So, for those who are still not convinced, here are eight indicators that it's probably time to resort to[self storage in Mumbai](https://stownest.com/self-storage-mumbai) and not simply deal with the evidence of your clutter management successes anymore.


### **1.You’re Moving But the Dates Don’t Match**


A common reason people store with us when moving to Mumbai is that they have a gap between their old lease ending and when their new home is ready. Belongings sitting without having to rent a bigger temporary flat to house them is what they need a safe place for during this time.


### **2. You're in the Middle of Redevelopment**


Mumbai has thousands of buildings currently undergoing the redevelopment process. As a resident, you are often given a very small window of time to evacuate the building with no idea when a new flat will be moving in ready. **[Redevelopment storage in Mumbai](https://stownest.com/blog/mumbai-household-storage-services)** solves this issue. They hold an entire home for the entire process.


### **3. You're Renovating and Furniture Is in the Way**


Dust, paint and contractors spread throughout the house aren't the best combination for your furniture. If you've been covering furniture with sheets, most of the time that's a sign that items should be moved to storage.


### **4. Your New Home Is Smaller Than Your Old One**


When moving to Mumbai, a lot of people find that while downsizing, they still run into the problem of not everything fitting. Rather than rushing and making tough decisions, storage units provide you the luxury of time to figure out how you want to move.


### **5. Your Business Has Outgrown Its Space**


If your business inventory encroaches upon other areas, it's time to consider flexible business storage in Mumbai as opposed to committing to a full warehouse lease because you may not need this level of long-term commitment.


### **6. You're Storing Seasonal Items You Rarely Use**


Items that are only used a few times per year such as festival decorations, winter clothes, or equipment do not have to be stored in your day to day living spaces. If you have items stored in cupboards that you use daily, that is a clear sign that you need storage.


### **7. You’ve Inherited or Kept Belongings You Can’t Fit**


Family heirlooms and sentimental items may be difficult to let go, but they’re a pain to manage without the proper storage. It’s for these reasons self-storage was designed. Self-storage means you are able to keep the things that mean the most to you without having to force those items to fit into a smaller space.


### **8. You’ve Been Saying “I’ll Deal With It Later”**


When people wait months or weeks at a time to make a decision about how to handle piles of stuff, boxes, or furniture, it’s usually a very good indication of the need for a storage solution. You don’t have to make that next decision right away. With storage, you can finally make that decision without worrying about that item taking over the rest of your life.


Recognize the Signs What happens to everyone once or twice will eventually happen to everyone. In these situations, the next step is a storage solution. You should be separating the items you need more often from the items you need less often and safely store the latter. Here is where **[pickup and delivery storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage)** is exceptional. One of the main features of this service is items are collected straight from your house, and stored safely until you decide you want it back, without having to go to a regular self storage unit.


## **Waiting Won't Solve Your Space Problem**


The majority of homeowners aren't calling storage companies when they first have the urge to declutter, they call when their storage needs become a stressor. By taking care of the problem early on, before it hinders your everyday life, you are taking the right measures for your health and well being.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. What are the signs I need to use a storage unit in Mumbai?**


You probably need a self storage unit if you’re in the middle of a move, renovation, development, redevelopment, or if your business inventory is creating a storage clutter issue in your workspace.


**2. Is self storage usable in Mumbai for temporary purposes like a move?**


Yes, People use self storage to help them move when your old lease is up and your next permanent home isn’t ready.


**3. Can I store my furniture while my home is in the process of being redeveloped?**


Yes, Redevelopment self storage is made to store the contents of an entire house while the home undergoes a redevelopment.


**4. Can growing inventory for a small business be stored using a self storage unit?**


Yes, **[Self storage](https://stownest.com/)** can be a stopgap measure for business inventory that may need more space than a traditional lease allows.
